findings.problem: With no hint, the bare prompt to pack also allows the common separable verb einpacken (to pack up, to wrap), so a learner could give either answer.
findings.fix: hint: a suitcase or bag (not einpacken)

back.target: to pack (a suitcase or bag); also to grab, to manage
back.example: Have you packed your suitcase yet?

note: In subtitles packen is also common as colloquial to manage (Wir packen das!) and to grab, which could be worth a later card.
